name: Ridged Multifractal
definition: A fractal noise technique that creates ridge-like structures by taking the absolute value of noise, subtracting from an offset, and squaring the result, with feedback from previous octaves.
summary: Ridged Multifractal generates sharp, linear features like terrain ridges by applying a non-linear transformation to noise absolute values with inter-octave feedback, unlike standard FBM's soft clouds.
